findings.text: The module docstring lists closing a premise, bringing a triple to its check and reporting where the tactic stopped, but the module now also holds the resolution-premise inspection (`resolutionPremise`, `hintedResolution`). Fix: add the inspection of the resolution premise of a kind rule to the module description.

The entry assumes that 78e27e58 is "the allocation change", but that commit is "Resolve the sent statement before trying the registered equations" and the status file uses "checker allocation" for a different, earlier change. Fix: name 78e27e58 by what it does, for example "after the resolution-first rule selection at 78e27e58".
